title: Guardian Puppet: Unexpected Comedy
next_chapter_hook: As the puppet turned to lead the way, an unusual gleam flickered in its hollow eye sockets. A deep voice echoed through the ruins: 'Interesting human... You remind me of someone from long ago.'

text.content: Chen Ji stood deep within the ruins of Tianqing Sect, his fingers still retaining the warmth of the earlier blood pulse agitation. He took a deep breath, suppressing the strange sensation for now—there would be time to pursue the past later. Before him, a stone puppet over three zhang tall was slowly awakening. Its body was forged from ancient Mysterious Iron, every line carved with forbidden formation runes. Pale blue soul flames burned in its hollow eye sockets as it coldly examined this uninvited guest.

dialogue.content: (Cupping hands in salute with an innocuous smile) Junior Chen Ji, Servant Disciple of Tianqing Sect, stumbled into this place by accident. I have absolutely no intention of causing offense. May I beg your indulgence, Senior?

text.content: The puppet's eye sockets flickered with soul fire, as if scrutinizing some absurd matter. A moment later, a senile, mechanical voice resonated from its chest: 'Servant Disciple?' The tone carried a hint of mockery, 'Those capable of reaching the third layer's entrance are no ordinary individuals. Brat, do you comprehend the consequences of deceiving a guardian?'

dialogue.content: Junior speaks only the truth.' Chen Ji revealed a simple, honest smile, thinking to himself that this puppet was much easier to deal with than that old fox Ling Yuan—at least its questions were all out in the open.

text.content: The puppet fell silent for a moment, then suddenly stepped forward. With a thunderous roar, the ground trembled, and a magnificent pressure bore down upon Chen Ji like a collapsing mountain. Its voice turned grim: 'Since you claim to be a Servant Disciple, let's test whether you possess a servant's resolve.'

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice suddenly echoed in Chen Ji's ear, carrying a hint of schadenfreude) Oh? Tianqing Sect's waste disciple? I thought you had some incredible abilities, turns out you're just someone who gets scared silly by a puppet?

text.content: Chen Ji rolled his eyes mentally. This Demonic Path Saintess certainly knew how to pick her moments to watch a show. He ignored Ye Qing's mockery and carefully examined the intricate patterns on the puppet's body—if brute force wouldn't work, he'd have to rely on cunning. He suddenly noticed an extremely faint crack near the puppet's chest, as if it had been struck by some powerful force but never truly repaired.

choice.prompt: How does Chen Ji respond to the puppet's overwhelming pressure?

choices.description: Continue playing the废物 character, use exaggerated performance to lower the puppet's guard, and look for weaknesses.

text.content: Chen Ji's legs went soft, and he collapsed directly to the ground, trembling violently like a sieve: 'S-Senior, spare my life! I truly am just a passing servant! Please have mercy and release me! I have an elderly mother who is eighty, and...'

choices.description: Mock the puppet about the crack in its chest, enrage it to expose more weaknesses.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of worldly insight: 'This wound of yours, Senior... Was it left by Tianqing Sect's founding Patriarch? Unhealed for a thousand years, it must hurt terribly, doesn't it?'

choices.description: Calmly analyze the situation, point out that brute confrontation benefits neither party, try to negotiate with the puppet.

text.content: Chen Ji folded his hands behind his back, his expression serene: 'Senior, you've guarded this place for a thousand years, surely you've grown weary by now? Instead of wasting time with Junior here, why not make a deal?'

The puppet's movements suddenly froze. Its soul flames leapt violently, as if something it didn't want to recall had been touched. Silence spread through the ruins, the air nearly solidifying. Chen Ji secretly rejoiced in his heart—bet correctly!

dialogue.content: (Pressing the advantage, voice carrying a hint of emotion) A thousand years have passed, Senior. Do you still remember the sensation of that sword strike? Although Junior's cultivation is insignificant, I know one thing—a true expert never lets an enemy leave with a wound.

text.content: The puppet suddenly let out a low laugh, that laughter carrying some indescribable bitterness: 'You little whelp... are somewhat interesting.' Its pressure slowly receded, 'That sword strike a thousand years ago was indeed the greatest humiliation of my life. But...' Its eye sockets blazed with sudden brightness, 'On what grounds do you speak for that heartless man?'

choice.prompt: The puppet's pressure receded but its questions became more pointed. How does Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Question the puppet: Since it hates Tianqing Sect's founding Patriarch so much, why does it still guard this place? There must be some hidden reason.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly: 'Junior wouldn't dare speak for anyone. Just curious—since you despise Tianqing Sect so deeply, why have you been willing to guard this place for a thousand years? Could it be... you were waiting for someone?'

choices.description: Lower one's posture, claim to be just a Servant Disciple who knows nothing about those grievances, only wanting to leave alive.
choices.visible_reward: Makes the Puppet Relax Its Guard

dialogue.content: Chen Ji waved苦笑 and said: 'Senior misunderstands. Junior truly is just a servant. How would I know about the grievances of those great seniors? Even if you gave me ten胆子, I wouldn't dare speak for anyone.'

text.content: The puppet fell silent. After a long while, it let out a long sigh, that sigh carrying a hint of desolation: 'Waiting for someone?' Its voice became distant, 'What I've been waiting for... is an answer.' At this moment, a mocking voice once again rang in Chen Ji's mind.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice dripped with undisguised mockery) Is this the手段 of a righteous sect's genius? Chatting about life and ideals with a pile of scrap metal? No wonder your Tianqing Sect's downfall wasn't unwarranted.

text.content: Chen Ji silently added Ye Qing to his mental ledger. This Demonic Path Saintess had a sharp tongue, but she was oddly accurate—indeed, it did resemble chatting about life. However, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly—precisely because of this, this thousand-year-old senior before him would be more likely to reveal weaknesses! He suddenly spoke: 'The answer Senior awaits... could it be 'why was that sword strike made'?'

The puppet's body shuddered violently! Its soul flames leapt intensely, as if the deepest wound had been prodded. That senile voice suddenly turned sharp: 'You... how do you know?!' Chen Ji felt a chill in his heart. He had only guessed randomly, never expecting to actually be right. There must be something behind this.

choice.prompt: With the puppet shaken, how does Chen Ji seize the opportunity?

choices.description: Continue asking about the truth of those events, excavate more secrets while the puppet is shaken.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, his gaze fixed directly on the puppet's hollow eye sockets: 'Senior, that sword strike... was it to protect something, or to destroy something?'

choices.description: Reveal the truth about possessing the Tianji Record Fragment, exchange this for the puppet's trust.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly raising his right hand—a page of yellowed, ancient paper materialized in his palm: the Tianji Record. 'Senior... the answer you await may be related to this object.'

The puppet's soul flames trembled violently, as if struggling with something. After a long while, it slowly spoke, its voice carrying a sense of relief: 'Tianji Record... So that's how it is. No wonder you've appeared here.' It suddenly knelt on one knee, a movement that even left Chen Ji stunned. 'A thousand years ago, my master left a dying command—if the bearer of the Tianji Record arrives, the Guardian Puppet shall open the path for them.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji blinked. This plot twist happened too quickly, right? A puppet that had been threatening to kill him moments ago now knelt before him? He ventured to ask: 'So... was that wave of pressure from Senior earlier... a test?'
(Ye Qing's laughter rang in his mind) Ha! That's hilarious! Tianqing Sect's Guardian Puppet was actually talked down by a废物 disciple with just words? How did you manage that? Teach me?

text.content: The puppet stood, its voice carrying a complex tone: 'Your wisdom... truly surprised me. For a thousand years, countless experts have broken into this place, all wanting to break the formation through force.' It paused, 'Only you... thought of 'inquiring the heart'.' Chen Ji's嘴角 twitched. It wasn't that he had thought of inquiring the heart, he simply couldn't fight and had no choice but to use words. Though there was no need to say this out loud.

The puppet turned and walked toward the depths of the ruins. Its voice echoed in the spacious stone chamber: 'Follow me. The true path to the third layer... only you can see.' Chen Ji followed, but in his heart he was pondering everything that had just transpired. The Tianji Record's founding master, the grievances of a thousand years ago, the Guardian Puppet's oath... these fragments were gradually piecing together a greater mystery. And Ye Qing's mocking voice still echoed in his ear: 'Is this the手段 of a righteous sect's genius?' He smiled slightly. Perhaps it was—after all, why use force when you can solve problems with words?
